title: devexp standup 2026-03-11
content:
DevEx Standup notes — 2026-03-11
Owner: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Aisha, Ethan, Marta, Ben, Priya, Liam (remote)
Duration: 25m

1) High level / agenda
- Quick sync on SDK release candidate (Python + JS), docs quickstart v2 draft, new samples repo layout, and the CI blocker on macOS for the Python wheel.
- Surface any rollout decisions for the hosted quickstart examples used in onboarding.

2) Updates (round-robin)
- Aisha (PM): Coordinating release timing for Python SDK v0.9.1-rc. Want to cut RC by EOD Thursday pending CI green. Updated release notes draft in docs PR. Also flagged a dependency bump (requests -> 3.0) that may impact some downstream examples.

- Ethan (SDK lead): Python and JS SDKs merged most feature flags. Python RC pipeline passing on linux/py3.10 and py3.11, failing on macOS wheels due to OpenSSL linkage issue (see blocker). Working on a workaround to build manylinux wheels and skip macOS binary on RC. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/342.

- Marta (Docs): Quickstart v2 draft is up in the docs repo; reorganized Getting Started to surface token-based auth, region selection, and hosted vs dedicated notes. Need a short explainer blurb about default rate limits in hosted mode. Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/98. Also updating screenshots for Console changes.

- Ben (Samples): Samples repo reorg complete — split into quickstarts, templates, and advanced-examples. Added chat + tools customer sample that demonstrates function calling. Need sign-off on default environment variables used in samples (API_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_KEY).

- Priya (DX ops / CI): Investigating macOS wheel failures. Root cause appears to be OpenSSL 3.2 incompat with the Python build container used by the macOS runner. Two options: vendor OpenSSL into the build, or mark macOS wheel build as non-blocking for RC and schedule a follow-up fix for GA. Leaning toward non-blocking for RC to avoid delay.

- Liam (Developer advocate): Prepared two short quickstart videos (2–3m) for onboarding flow. Need final sample snippets and updated console screenshots before publishing. Also adding timestamps and captions.

3) Blockers / Risks
- macOS wheel CI failures block an official universal wheel for Python SDK. Impact: some customers who rely on pip-install on macOS might see warnings or be required to install from source. (Owner: Priya, ETA: 2026-03-13 for decision on RC tag behavior).

- Dependency bump to requests 3.0 flagged by Aisha — needs compatibility check with consumer apps and samples (Owner: Aisha, Ethan, ETA: 2026-03-12).

- Docs: Quickstart v2 includes region selection content that needs Legal review for implied regional guarantees. (Owner: Marta, ETA: 2026-03-15 to route to legal).

4) Decisions made
- Cut Python SDK v0.9.1-rc without macOS wheel if CI cannot be fixed by Thursday EOD. Mark macOS wheel build as non-blocking and create follow-up ticket DEVEXP-2124 to produce signed macOS wheels for GA.

- Use REDWOOD_API_KEY as canonical env var in samples going forward (consensus from team). Create a short migration note in samples README. (Action: Ben).

- Publish quickstart videos alongside docs PR once screenshots finalized. Schedule publish for Monday next week in onboarding flow. (Action: Liam + Marta).

5) Action items (owners + due dates)
- Priya: Finalize approach for macOS wheel (vendor vs non-blocking) and update PR comments. Due: 2026-03-13.
- Ethan: If macOS remains blocked, add clear installer note and ensure pip path falls back to source build; update release notes. Due: 2026-03-12.
- Aisha: Coordinate communication plan with Growth for RC announcement and include known macOS caveat. Due: 2026-03-12.
- Marta: Add legal review request for region copy and finish screenshot updates. Due: 2026-03-15.
- Ben: Update samples to use REDWOOD_API_KEY and add migration note to README; cut samples patch release. Due: 2026-03-12.
- Liam: Finalize quickstart videos, incorporate captions, and handover to comms. Due: 2026-03-15.

6) Notes / follow-ups
- Follow-up deep dive on dependency impact (requests 3.0) scheduled Friday 11:00am with Eng infra and a couple of external consumers (calendar invite sent).
- Consider adding a small CI job to smoke-test wheel installs on a macOS-latest runner that uses a minimal environment, to catch these linkage issues earlier. (Owner: Priya).
- Add a short FAQ entry in the quickstart about supported platforms and how to install from source if binary wheel unavailable. (Owner: Marta/Ben).

7) Parking lot / next topics for next standup
- Quickstart v2 GA plan and rollout timeline for onboarding funnel changes.
- Metrics / telemetry: add token-cost examples to quickstarts (est cost per sample).
- Canary plan for samples that call tools — ensure tools endpoints are available in sandbox.

End of notes.
